name: mobile_start_menu_visible
description: Load start menu at mobile viewport, verify main button container exists and is within viewport. Catches: start menu buttons cut off or off-screen at mobile size.

name: mobile_pause_menu_accessible
description: Start game at mobile viewport, trigger pause, verify pause menu elements are within viewport. Catches: pause menu options cut off at mobile size.

name: mobile_touch_targets
description: Check all visible interactive buttons meet minimum touch target size (44x44px per Apple HIG). Catches: buttons too small to tap on mobile.

name: mobile_canvas_covers_viewport
description: Verify game canvas covers >70% of mobile viewport (game area not obscured by HUD/overlays). Catches: HUD overlay too large, gameplay area too small at mobile.
